title: Lockheed Martin coherent matter wave beam patent

tellings.quote: Um there's a Lockheed Martin patent called a coherent matter wave beam that deals with using the Aharonov-Bohm

plain: The defense company Lockheed Martin holds a patent for something called a coherent matter wave beam, according to a guest named Dave Rossi, who describes it without pointing to the document itself. He says the patent makes use of the Aharonov-Bohm effect, an effect in quantum physics. Rossi raises it as a sign that a major weapons maker is working on very unusual physics.
